items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Percy and Caffrey Darenbourg, they were cousins. They were two guitar players.

ctx.x: Joe Darenbourg? No. Percy and Caffrey Darenbourg, they were cousins. They were two guitar players. But anyway, the guy's name was "berg" something, but I'll give you his name. But Mayo...I was helping him organize the people 'cause what they did, they had like a caravan kind of thing, and they would go into a city
and they would go to a furniture store and go into the rug department...did you know this?...
